jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for an Associate Product Manage r to join our MONOPOLY GO! Game team in Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis (3X week in office).

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

What You Will Do

Join the team responsible for keeping MONOPOLY GO!'s live minigames accurate, reliable, and ready for players. You will help coordinate recurring events from planning and implementation through playtesting, release readiness, and post-event learning, while building the product judgment to take on broader responsibilities over time.

- Oversee the operational health of live-minigame cycles, maintaining transparency across milestones, ownership, and potential project blockers.

- Facilitate rigorous playtesting sessions; documenting findings, managing defect triage, and ensuring all critical regressions are resolved.

- Audit final configurations against technical specifications to identify discrepancies and finalize pending decisions prior to deployment.

- Drive cross-functional synchronization between Engineering, Design, Art, to ensure seamless event execution.

- Maintain comprehensive documentation of strategic choices and project velocity to foster team alignment and clarity.

- Support launch readiness by preempting risks and refining operational workflows through rigorous post-release analysis.

Leverage AI tools and automation to streamline evidence comparison and documentation while ensuring the integrity of project outputs.

What We’re Looking For

- Authentic enthusiasm for the mobile gaming landscape and a desire to understand the mechanics behind maintaining long-term game integrity and engagement.

- Proven background in operations, product, design, or analytics, developed through professional roles, academic projects, or significant practical application.

- Meticulous precision and execution, capable of auditing features from initial documentation to final release to ensure absolute consistency.

- Intellectual curiosity and a systems-oriented mindset; you seek to master new platforms and address core issues rather than surface-level fixes.

- Proactive communication skills to highlight discrepancies, define ownership, and advocate for resolution when launch readiness is threatened.

- Articulate delivery and the capacity to synchronize efforts across diverse functional groups and shifting project timelines.

- Exceptional administrative skills, with the ability to navigate multiple concurrent events through various lifecycle phases without losing focus.

- Technical aptitude and a history of leveraging automation and AI to enhance workflow efficiency and the reliability of project outcomes.

Bonus Points

- Previous involvement with mobile gaming, live-service products, or similarly dynamic digital environments where agility is paramount.

- Proficiency in navigating data and digital platforms to diagnose complex challenges and substantiate strategic decision-making.

- Demonstrated history of implementing AI solutions and automation to optimize operational workflows and elevate team-wide productivity.

Please submit your CV in English.

jobs.title: Director of Product Pikmin Bloom
jobs.description:
Scopely Explore is looking for a Director of Product to join its Leadership Team and help shape the future of one of the world’s leading location-based live service games.

The Director of Product owns the product strategy that connects player value with business outcomes. Working closely with the General Manager and functional leaders, this role defines the long-term product direction, establishes success metrics, and develops the winning thesis that differentiates Pikmin Bloom in the market.

From feature strategy and LiveOps to experimentation, game economy, and player insights, the Director of Product brings together Design, Engineering, Production, Marketing, and Analytics to make informed product decisions that delight players and drive sustainable business growth.

What You Will Do

- Own the long-term product strategy, KPI framework, and success metrics for Pikmin Bloom.

- Partner closely with the General Manager and Leadership Team to translate the game’s vision into a compelling product strategy and roadmap.

- Develop and continuously refine a winning product thesis grounded in player insight, market understanding, competitive analysis, and long-term differentiation.

- Collaborate with Design, Production, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, and LiveOps to deliver gameplay experiences that improve both player satisfaction and business performance.

- Establish a high bar for product thinking by reviewing, improving, and occasionally creating Product Briefs, product strategies, and feature proposals.

- Drive data-informed decision making through experimentation, market analysis, audience sizing, player research, and competitive insights.

- Define strategies that strengthen engagement, retention, monetization, and long-term player value while maintaining the game’s creative vision.

- Partner with LiveOps leadership to ensure every feature meaningfully contributes to seasonal planning, content strategy, and the long-term health of the game.

- Build scalable product management practices, operating models, and decision-making frameworks that improve execution across the organization.

- Foster a player-centric, outcome-oriented product culture built on curiosity, collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

- AI-Driven Product Leadership: Proactively leverage AI to accelerate player research, competitive analysis, experimentation, and product strategy development. Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities to strengthen the team’s winning thesis, improve product quality, and enable faster, better-informed product decisions.

- Required in-office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of product leadership experience in free-to-play mobile games.

- Proven track record of operating and growing successful live service games after launch.

- Demonstrated success defining product strategy and shipping features that deliver measurable KPI impact.

- Demonstrated ability to develop and evolve a winning product thesis that differentiates a game through deep player understanding, market insight, competitive analysis, and continuous experimentation.

- Deep understanding of game economy, LiveOps, experimentation, product analytics, and player behavior.

- Experience leading cross-functional teams across Product, Design, Engineering, Production, Marketing, and Analytics.

- Significant experience working as a Product Analyst , ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or other consumer digital products.

- Intellectual curiosity with a passion for solving complex business problems through data.

- Fluent English, written and spoken.

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Dublin on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager , you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

- Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs

- Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences

- Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales

- Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies

- Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation

- Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements

- Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting

- Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

- Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game

- Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development

- Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision

- Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels

- Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others.
